customManagers.description: The python-version input of astral-sh/setup-uv steps in CI, which the github-actions manager does not read, so the python runtime PR moves it with requires-python. Looked up as the python image, whose x.y tags keep the same precision.

packageRules.description: Python non-major updates in one PR. FastAPI and uvicorn stay out and get their own PRs: a FastAPI minor can change telemetry behavior (INFRA-84, INFRA-105).

SQLAlchemy patches ride in the python group; minors (2.1 is a real migration) get their own PR on dashboard approval. separateMultipleMinor, not separateMinorPatch, which would move the patch to its own branch.
The SQLAlchemy minor leaves the python group and waits for approval; keep this rule after the python group rule so its groupName wins.
npm non-major updates in one PR. recharts gets its own PR: any move trips the TBD-528 version tripwire (chart-animation-gate.test.ts).
npm updates wait 1 day after publishing: pnpm refuses younger packages (ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION, INFRA-77), and one fresh package would fail the whole npm group.
GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates in one PR.
Docker non-major and digest updates in one PR.
OpenTelemetry packages move together in their own PR, apart from the ecosystem groups: their versions are released in lockstep, and INFRA-84 owns the telemetry standard.
All majors (libraries, actions, images) wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, approve them one at a time, after the non-major groups have landed.
Python runtime upgrade (a new 3.x is a minor in Renovate's terms): Dockerfiles, requires-python and CI move together in one PR, on dashboard approval only.
Node runtime major: Dockerfiles, CI and @types/node move together in one PR, on dashboard approval only.
The setup-uv python-version is a plain x.y input: never pin a digest to it.
structlog majors are never proposed: INFRA-105 removes structlog.
Datastore image majors are never proposed: production versions are owned by aws-infra (clusters/platform/data), and local and CI images must not run ahead of them.
DigitalOcean-era infrastructure that INFRA-49 and INFRA-103 remove: no updates.
